data.name: Note_Counted
data.value: Netto counts your household's tax less what your partner would owe filing alone on their own income: that, and what is withheld on their income, are left out.

data.name: Meaning_Quotient
data.value: In a joint return, part of the larger professional income is attributed to the partner who earns less, so it is taxed in their lower bands.

data.name: Hint
data.value: Your partner and the people who depend on you. Married or legally cohabiting, you and your partner are taxed jointly: one assessment in both names, each of you taxed on the scale on your own income with your own tax-free amount. The marital quotient attributes part of the larger professional income to the partner who earns less, taxed in their lower bands. Living together without a declaration of legal cohabitation is single for tax. Your dependants raise the tax-free amount, the part of the income taxed at nothing, with or without a partner.
